statement: The repeated-step transfer of a grid mode is the product of the three axis symbols of the route at that mode's angles, raised to the power M for the value channel and multiplied by one derivative factor in place of the last value factor for the derivative channels. The predicted histories below are the exact modal L2 errors that arithmetic implies, including the aliasing of the packet onto the coarse grids.

amendment_1.scope: The augmentation is carried at the Lagrange widths 8, 12 and 16, the twelve point width being the wall evaluator of the paper; BMC11 is added to the controls; the ladder is refined so that successive rungs differ by at most a factor 1.25; the worst channel history on the rung below each realized minimum is reported as a multiple of the one percent bar; and the rule of the contract is applied verbatim against each Lagrange width separately.
amendment_1.statement: The arithmetic is the one the original block states, evaluated for the three Lagrange widths, for BMC11 and on the refined ladder. The rung below each predicted minimum carries the worst of the five channel histories through step M, reported as a multiple of the one percent bar, so the margin by which that rung fails is part of the prediction.
